+func GetFileMode(key string) fs.FileMode {
+	modeStr := viper.GetString(key)
+
+	mode, err := strconv.ParseUint(modeStr, headscale.Base8, headscale.BitSize64)
+	if err != nil {
+		return PermissionFallback
+	}
+
+	return fs.FileMode(mode)
+}
